title: The Advanced Shipment Tracking for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the…
description: The Advanced Shipment Tracking for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress contains an SQL Injection vulnerability in the tracking_provider parameter of a REST endpoint. This affects all versions up to and including 3.9. Authenticated users with Shop Manager-level access or higher can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially extracting sensitive database information.
